documents.text: Patrick Regan (Medal of Honor, 1918) Patrick J. Regan (March 25, 1882October 30, 1943) was an officer in the United States Army who received the Medal of Honor for his actions during World War I. Regan was born in Middleborough, Massachusetts on March 25, 1882 and died October 30, 1943. He is buried in Mount Olivet Cemetery, Bloomfield, New Jersey. Rank and organization: Second Lieutenant, U.S. Army, 115th Infantry, 29th Division. Place and date: At Bois-de-Consenvoye, France; October 8, 1918. Entered service at: Los Angeles, California. Birth: March 25, 1882; Middleborough, Massachusetts. General Orders: War Department, General Orders No. 50
